keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: Clow et al. 2025 ocean–sea-ice hindcast compset. One model day at the start of JRA55-do year 1958. Not the published 122-year integration and not ChlOSP.

entries.title: CESM2 OMIP2 JRA 1-year test
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: One model year of the Clow et al. 2025 ocean–sea-ice compset, reading only JRA55-do 1958. Startup from the climatological initial state.

entries.title: CESM2 OMIP2 JRA two-cycle hindcast
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: Published Clow et al. 2025 ocean–sea-ice hindcast without ChlOSP. Climatological startup, then two cycles of JRA55-do 1958–2018. One model year per submission. Not submitted by this configuration step.

entries.title: CESM2 gx3v7 normal-year 1-day smoke
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: Coarse POP2–MARBL pipeline on gx3v7 with CORE normal-year forcing. One model day. Not the Clow et al. 2025 JRA hindcast.

entries.title: CESM2 gx3v7 normal-year 1-year test
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: One model year of G1850ECO on gx3v7. Normal-year forcing, startup from the climatological initial state. Not the Clow et al. 2025 JRA hindcast.

entries.title: CESM2 gx3v7 normal-year 122-year run
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: 122 model years of G1850ECO on gx3v7, one year per submission. Normal-year forcing repeats. Not the published JRA hindcast.

entries.title: E3SM MPAS-Ocean MARBL JRA 1-day smoke
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: Cross-model analogue of the Clow et al. 2025 ocean–sea-ice hindcast. One model day of JRA55-do year 1958. Not an exact CESM2 reproduction.

entries.title: E3SM MPAS-Ocean MARBL JRA 1-year test
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: One model year of the E3SM analogue, reading only JRA55-do 1958. Startup from the MARBL initial state. Not an exact CESM2 reproduction.

entries.title: E3SM MPAS-Ocean MARBL JRA two-cycle hindcast
keywords: Clow 2025 CESM2 SST 与叶绿素卫星采样
entries.description: Cross-model analogue of the Clow et al. 2025 hindcast. Two cycles of JRA55-do 1958-2018. CO2 uses the OMIP series aligned to cycle 2. Aerosol deposition stays at the compset climatology.

entries.title: GCB 2023 · CLM5.0 · post-AD 自旋

entries.title: GCB 2023 · CLM5.0 · S0
entries.description: TRENDY2023 S0。工业化前 CO2 276.59 ppm，PI 气候流，1700 年地表，不做施肥。从 post-AD 的 0400-01-01 在 1701-01-01 混合启动。STOP_N=100、RESUBMIT=2。脚本没有再写接到 2022 的后一段。

entries.title: GCB 2023 · CLM5.0 · S1
entries.description: TRENDY2023 S1。历史 CO2，PI 气候，1700 年地表且 flanduse_timeseries 置空，不做施肥。第一段 STOP_N=75、RESUBMIT=1（1701–1850）；第二段换成 1851–2022 的 namelist，STOP_N=86、RESUBMIT=1，并打开瞬变人口。

entries.title: GCB 2023 · CLM5.0 · S2
entries.description: TRENDY2023 S2。历史 CO2 和瞬变气候，土地覆被仍固定在 1700 年，不做施肥。1701–1850 用 PI 段 namelist；1851–1900 换瞬变气溶胶、城市、人口和氮沉降；1901–2022 把 DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_END 设为 2022。

entries.title: GCB 2023 · CLM5.0 · S3
entries.description: TRENDY2023 S3。在 S2 的气候和 CO2 上使用 1700–2022 土地覆被时间序列，打开施肥和 do_grossunrep。第一段 STOP_N=50、RESUBMIT=2（1701–1850），之后同样分 1851–1900 和 1901–2022。

entries.description: 1600-01-01 至 2100-01-01（终点不含），50 年一段、再提交 9 次。工业化前强迫。论文的 500 年控制。公开分段目前列到 1999。

entries.title: Seland 2020 E02 · NorESM2-LM · abrupt-4xCO2 · 500 年
entries.description: 0001-01-01 至 0501-01-01（终点不含）。与 piControl 同一初值，CO2 立刻四倍。图 3 画到第 150 年，Gregory 的 500 年窗口也用过。生产积分继续到第 620 年。

entries.title: Seland 2020 E03 · NorESM2-LM · 1pctCO2 · 165 年
entries.description: 0001-01-01 至 0166-01-01（终点不含）。CO2 每年增加 1%。TCR 用第 60–80 年相对 piControl 的温度差。生产积分到第 165 年。

entries.title: Seland 2020 E16 · NorESM2-MM · abrupt-4xCO2 · 150 年
entries.description: 0001-01-01 至 0151-01-01（终点不含）。与 piControl 同一初值。图 3 和公开案例都到第 150 年。

entries.title: Seland 2020 E19 · NorESM2-MM · historical · r2 · 1850–2014
entries.description: 1850-01-01 至 2015-01-01（终点不含）。论文写三个成员在自旋末期相隔约 30 年。公开总表有生产案例 NHISTfrc2_02_f09_tn14_20200427，没有写出分支日，本 case 因此不填 RUN_REFDATE。

entries.title: Seland 2020 E20 · NorESM2-MM · historical · r3 · 1850–2014

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · AD
entries.description: TRENDY2026 加速分解自旋。CO2 固定 277.58 ppm，气候循环 1901–1920，1700 年地表。SASU 从 0361-01-01 衔接，与 STOP_N=20、RESUBMIT=17 的 360 年一致。本地 DATM 读取 GCB2026 的 CRU–JRA-3Q。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · postSASU
entries.description: TRENDY2026 正常分解自旋。从 SASU 的 0321-01-01 混合启动，积分 280 年至 0281-01-01。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S0
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S0。CO₂ 固定 277.58 ppm，循环 1901–1920 年气象，从 post-SASU 的 0281-01-01 混合启动。积分覆盖 1700–2025。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S1
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S1。历史 CO2（cmip6_20tr，diagnostic）。建例脚本把气候循环在 1901–1920。公开 namelist 有 1700–1849 和 1850–2015 两段。本地 DATM 读取 GCB2026 的 CRU–JRA-3Q。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S2
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S2。历史 CO2。建例脚本把 DATM 设为 1901–1920。公开 namelist 有 1700–1849 和 1850–2015 两段。组件集使用 CRUJRA2024b；DATM 文件名是 CRUJRAv4.10。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S3
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S3。历史 CO2，土地覆被时间序列文件名到 2026。这次提交只包含 1700–1849 的 user_nl_clm。本地 DATM 读取 GCB2026 的 CRU–JRA-3Q。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S4
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S4。CO2 固定 277.58 ppm，建例脚本把气候循环在 1901–1920，土地覆被用瞬变序列。这是 GCB2026 新增的土地利用因子试验。组件集使用 CRUJRA2024b；DATM 文件名是 CRUJRAv4.10。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S5
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S5。历史 CO2，建例脚本把气候循环在 1901–1920，土地覆被用瞬变序列。本地 DATM 读取 GCB2026 的 CRU–JRA-3Q。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · S6
entries.description: TRENDY2026 S6。CO2 固定 277.58 ppm。建例脚本把 DATM 设为 1901–1920。仓库里名为 user_nl_clm_S6.1850-2013 的文件实际是 CRUJRAv4.10 1901–2025 的气象流清单，不是 CLM namelist，没有放进本目录。本地 DATM 读取 GCB2026 的 CRU–JRA-3Q。

entries.title: GCB 2026 · CLM6.0 · SASU
entries.description: TRENDY2026 土壤加速自旋。从 AD 的 0361-01-01 混合启动，积分 320 年至 0321-01-01。

entries.title: GCB2026 · ELM · S0
entries.description: TRENDY v15 S0。CO₂ 与氮沉降固定 1700 年，气候循环 1901–1920 年，土地利用与氮肥固定 1700 年。提交的 NBP 为 192×288 网格上的逐月输出。

entries.title: GCB2026 · ELM · S1
entries.description: TRENDY v15 S1。CO₂ 与氮沉降历史变化，气候循环 1901–1920 年，土地利用与氮肥固定 1700 年。提交的 NBP 为 192×288 网格上的逐月输出。

entries.title: GCB2026 · ELM · S2
entries.description: TRENDY v15 S2。CO₂ 与氮沉降历史变化，气候历史变化，土地利用与氮肥固定 1700 年。提交的 NBP 为 192×288 网格上的逐月输出。

entries.title: GCB2026 · ELM · S3 · 1700–1849
entries.description: 从平衡 restart 启动。CO₂ 自 1700 年历史变化，循环 1901–1920 年气象。土地利用和氮沉降沿用输入序列首年 1850。

entries.title: GCB2026 · ELM · S3 · 1850–1900

entries.title: Burned area with GLEAM predictors
entries.description: Use GLEAM root-zone soil moisture and evaporative stress as historical predictors alongside CESM2 and land-use inputs. The Gallery figures characterize the processed GLEAM source across its full period.

entries.title: Gridded fire and non-fire nitrogen deposition
entries.description: Inference on the global monthly CAM f19 grid using ERA5 and CAM emissions and deposition predictors. The selected project configuration reuses fitted models and the feature archive for its 2023 prediction window.

entries.title: Station wet deposition
entries.description: Use ERA5, CAM wet deposition, emissions and socioeconomic predictors to predict station NH₄⁺ and NO₃⁻ targets and infer on a 0.25° grid with the historical Fire_Ndep station configuration.

entries.title: Zhao et al. (2025) burned-area workflow
entries.description: Reproduce the burned-area workflow using GFED4.1s, one CESM2 member, XGBoost, leave-one-year-out validation and two SSPs. The experiment notes document differences in climate inputs and bias correction from the paper.

entries.title: China air quality · 2023

entries.title: Surface weather across China
entries.description: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information Integrated Surface Database (ISD-Lite).

entries.title: Global greenhouse gas concentrations
entries.description: NOAA's Annual Greenhouse Gas Index companion table combines measurements and historical records. This edition was archived by the FaIR reproduction project.

entries.title: Beijing hourly air quality station archive
keywords: PM₂.₅ starts in December 2013 and O₃ in April 2014. Both end October 11, 2025. Some years and days are missing.

entries.title: 2023 CAM Monthly Air Quality Validation for China
entries.description: Pair CAM surface O₃ and PM₂.₅ with the 2023 CNEMC monthly station dataset. Use CF time bounds to assign records to months.

entries.title: CAM Monthly Wet Nitrogen Deposition Validation
entries.description: Pair gridded model fluxes with wet deposition observations by site and month. Integrate rates over each month using the model calendar and summarize metrics by monitoring network.

entries.title: Archived BTH CAMx Station Pairs
entries.description: Reuse the BTH project's daily D01 O₃ station pairs for summer 2023. Apply the documented factor of 1.09375 to match reported concentrations.

entries.title: CAMx C07 D01 Hourly Grid Validation
entries.description: Reconstruct spatial and temporal coordinates from I/O API NetCDF. Use Beijing time to aggregate hourly fields into daily maximum eight-hour mean O₃ and daily mean NO₂, SO₂, and CO, then pair them with CNEMC station observations.

entries.title: June 2023 CNEMC Daily Station Dataset
entries.description: Calculate daily maximum eight-hour mean O₃ and daily means for five other pollutants for June 1–3, 2023 using Beijing time. The dataset supports CAMx and WRF-GC.

entries.title: 2023 CNEMC Monthly Station Dataset
entries.description: Aggregate hourly O₃ and PM₂.₅ records from China's national monitoring network by UTC month. Require valid records for at least 75% of the hours in each month and produce a station dataset for CAM and EAM.

entries.title: Rebuild Multi-Network Wet Nitrogen Deposition Workbooks
entries.description: Clean and merge monthly wet nitrogen deposition from EANET, CAPMoN, NTN, INDAAF, and EMEP. Export individual network workbooks, the station list, and the combined workbook.

entries.title: WRF-GC Daily Air Quality Validation for China
entries.description: Read native wrfout files and pair model output with CNEMC stations inside the model domain. Validate daily maximum eight-hour mean O₃, daily mean NO₂, and daily mean dry surface PM₂.₅.

entries.title: 2019 Xu Daily Station O₃ Dataset
entries.description: Extract 2019 station O₃ for China from the global archive, preserving the original date labels and daily maximum eight-hour means.

entries.title: CAM and EAM Shared Station Sample Comparison
entries.description: Select the sites and periods with valid model–observation pairs in all three cases, e07, e15, and e17. Recompute metrics for each model using the shared sample.

entries.title: Xu 2026 Cross-Model Validation of China Wildfire Simulations
entries.description: Use the same 2023 CNEMC monthly station dataset to validate EarthModelHub cases CESM/CAM e07 and E3SM/EAM e15 and e17. Each case's validation YAML references the case.yaml in its directory and reads the FireEarth history archive.
